item.title: Your video call setup says more about you than you think
item.description:
The first impression you make on a video call isn't your words — it's your webcam, microphone, and lighting. This WFH Dads issue argues that the gear worth paying for is the gear people actually perceive: a decent camera, clear audio, and good light do more for how you're received at work than almost any other home-office upgrade.

The piece pairs that advice with a productive home office tour as its recommendation of the week, framing the setup as a professional investment rather than a gadget splurge. For anyone still working remote or hybrid, it's a reminder that on camera, production quality reads as credibility.
